digest.component_or_area: LLM capabilities override table (Bedrock and Anthropic adapters)
propositions: The override table _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES is incomplete: it lists only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL is claude-opus-4-8, which rejects non-default temperature values with a 400 ValidationException and is unguarded

Both us.* and global.* Bedrock model ID prefixes reject temperature parameter, but the table keys on full model IDs so global.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 and global.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 remain unguarded even if their us.* twins are listed

The Anthropic adapter (direct path, not Bedrock) silently drops temperature via pydantic-ai's _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings and logs a warning, while Bedrock adapter has no such guard and fails with 400, causing Pass-2 determinism pins (temperature=0) to silently fail

The measured behavior shows temperature=1.0 (API default) succeeds while 0.0 and 0.5 fail on opus models, indicating rejection of explicit sampling parameter tunability rather than temperature being unsupported

The bare model IDs claude-opus-4-8 and claude-opus-4-7 must be added to the override table to guard both anthropic: and bedrock: provider paths with a single entry, and both us.* and global.* prefixes must be covered
